_doc: MISUMI HFS8-4080: a 80 x 40 mm aluminium extrusion of its 8 series, clear anodised (HFSB8-4080 is the same section in black). Dimensions, area, second moments and mass are from MISUMI's catalogue page; it is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (bending across the 40 mm). The drawn outline leaves out the four small lobes round the bore, the step inside each corner block and the hollows' rounded corners. MISUMI prints no section modulus or torsion constant.
name: profile-4080-misumi-hfs8

family.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

series.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

cells_across.rule: 2 cells side by side: 2 slots in each wide face

cells_up.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

corner_radius.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

slot.rule: Every face has the 8 series' slot
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

chamber_width.rule: The closed hollow between the two cells, behind a wall dimensioned 3 on the drawing each side: 40 less 6
chamber_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

chamber_length.rule: The hollow keeps its full width for about 15 mm, a wall of about 2.5 mm from each neighbouring slot's cavity, then steps in to the flanks. Not dimensioned
chamber_length.source: scaled off the section drawing on MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf (the drawing prints no figure for it)

bore_diameter.rule: Centre bore of each cell, "2-Ø10.5" on the drawing
bore_diameter.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

bore_thread.rule: End tapping (alteration LTP, RTP, TPW) cuts M12, 36 mm deep, in this bore
bore_thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-757, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_757.pdf

corner_hollow_width.rule: A closed square hollow in each corner, 6 on the drawing (its corners are rounded there; drawn square here)
corner_hollow_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

corner_hollow_wall.rule: The wall outside each corner hollow, 2 on the drawing
corner_hollow_wall.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

area.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

inertia_x.rule: Cross sectional moment of inertia 19.8 x 10^4 mm⁴ (the page's lx: the smaller, bending across the 40 mm)
inertia_x.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

inertia_y.rule: Cross sectional moment of inertia 71.9 x 10^4 mm⁴ (the page's ly: the larger, bending across the 80 mm)
inertia_y.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

mass_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

alloy.rule: Material of the HFS type, as the page's table gives it (the NFS type of the same section is A6063S-T5)
alloy.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

material.rule: The kit's rule set for A6N01SS-T5, from MISUMI's own mechanical properties table
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

lengths.rule: Fixed length parts (KHFS8-4080): 1000 and 4000 mm (4000 is the effective length)
lengths.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

cut_length_min.rule: Configurable length, from 50 mm in 0.5 mm steps
cut_length_min.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

cut_length_max.rule: Configurable length, to 4000 mm (6000 for some, by special order)
cut_length_max.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-633, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_633.pdf

cut_tolerance.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-629, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_629.pdf

straightness_per_metre.rule: Bend: 0.3 mm or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 38 mm (this section's is 89.4 mm), which is 1.00 mm in a metre. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
straightness_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf

twist_per_metre.rule: Twist: 1/4 degree or less in any 300 mm for a circumscribed circle over 76 mm (89.4 mm here), at most 3 degrees over the whole length. JIS special grade, as MISUMI's tolerance page gives it
twist_per_metre.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-514, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_513.pdf
